meta.title: Mesh Build
meta.description: Volume meshing and quality gate: snappyHexMesh (hex + layers + CHT), cfMesh, gmsh route D, project threshold checks.
meta.detail: Three tools: mesh_hints (knowledge cards), mesh_build (routes from data/engine.json plus snappy case scaffolding), mesh_check (checkMesh + mesh_gate per region). Routes and hints are extended with JSON data, no code changes.
